UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to (if using uWSGI deployment)

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to uWSGI ini file (if using uWSGI deployment)

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to uWSGI app ini file (if using uWSGI deployment)

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Config file for uWSGI bind settings (if using uWSGI deployment)

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section in uWSGI bind config file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Key for IP directive in uWSGI bind config

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Key for port directive in uWSGI bind config

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Key for workers directive in uWSGI bind config

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to Ceilometer main config file

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user under which the service runs

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group under which the service runs

PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name used for paths and user/group names
